statement: Descriptor-versus-alternate-path mismatch: SDL consumer source steam-c6-input-47 accepts a 46-byte 47 report, but this fresh physical direct-wired 1302 descriptor declares no input 47. Marked conflicted to keep the deployment mismatch explicit, not to dispute that SDL can parse 47 or claim firmware never emits it. Judgement: the physical-descriptor realization must not advertise 47; any 47 encoder remains an explicit test-only diagnostic outside this descriptor until further physical evidence. Existing consumer source claims remain unchanged.
